_comment: Expected building and floor for Experiment 2 - State Extraction from building signs.
_instructions: building: código del edificio (EPS, H) o null si solo hay planta. floor: número de planta como string. Para evaluar: Building Accuracy (cuando building != null), Floor Accuracy (siempre), Location Accuracy (building AND floor correctos cuando building != null).

_prompts._comment_legacy: Prompt anterior (solo edificio/planta): 'Extract all the information from the top right corner. Tell me the text next to EDIFICIO and the number next to PLANTA. Format it as: Building: [name], Floor: [number].'
_prompts.building_and_floor: Extract from the top right: building (EDIFICIO) and floor (PLANTA) as Building: X, Floor: Y. Then list the main facilities or areas shown on the sign.
_prompts.building_only: Which building am I in? Answer with only the building code (one or two letters).
_prompts.floor_only: Identify the floor number shown in the image. Answer with only the number (e.g. -2, -1, 0, 1, 2).
_prompts.landmarks: List the main facilities or areas shown on this sign (e.g. cafeteria, library, classrooms, meeting rooms, auditorium). Do not include room numbers or building/floor codes.

_landmarks_reference._comment: Keywords para landmarks (con sinonimos/variantes para mejorar recall).
